storyboard.instruction: Redesign the COMPLETE six-shot storyboard: centered text, richer meaningful elements, coherent arrangement. Retain every narration line and its conditions; keep six shots and the same groupings/durations (23,18,13,15,16,24 seconds). Compact JSON and brief notes. NEW supported primitive centered-text centers a single-line label inside its box. ALL labels must use centered-text with x:12,width:76,height:5, so every label sits on canvas center x=50. Use one short label at y:17 and an optional outcome at y:77. No tiny internal labels or left/right scattered captions. Max 2 labels/frame, each 1-3 words except exact source search phrases. Never Hypothetical/Demo/Illustrative. Fill central 70% with a designed group, not isolated clipart in white space. Background deep navy #121A30; layered panels #202D4A and #2C3B60; main ink #F8FAFF; activity violet #A497FF; bottleneck coral #FF7969; progress mint #54D5AD. Vary active colors with cause/effect, not random recoloring. Use 8-10 meaningful shapes per frame: main panel, search/message/approval cards, avatar or document symbols, status/progress marks and connectors where useful. Keep foreground icons >=20% width and square proportions (height about .56*width). Six scenes: search with two result cards; three independent people and same blocked document; workflow inspection with recurrence/time cues; five interviews shown as five distinct people plus shared workflow; manual offer with an explicit unpaid return path; conditional tool and retained evidence. Never show invented successful payment, testimonials, measurements or demand. Draw real start/end changes: rearrange cards, expose a blockage, connect separate reports, trace a workflow and pass or return at a checkpoint. No static decorative filler. Use start then hard-cut arrivals. Shapes only: supported primitives, positive bounds, string label always (empty for nontext). No code/URLs/assets/new fields. Preserve narration; save as a proposal, not approval.

shots.purpose: Proposal: narrow a broad pool of Reddit ideas to work-related complaints using the accepted search phrases.
shots.framing: Centered search panel with two large result cards; search phrases appear sequentially rather than together.
shots.subject: A work-community search feeding two candidate complaint cards.
shots.action: Present a mixed result pool. Cycle the centered heading through “doing this manually,” “is there a tool,” and “I'm tired of.” Rearrange matching cards beneath the search area while unmatched activity recedes. Hold on two candidates, without treating them as validated opportunities.
shots.continuity: Establish the document cards and coral unresolved-action marker that persist into the approval-queue example. Durations are planning estimates.

shots.purpose: Distinguish independent reports from repeated messages by one person, then make the narrated imagined approval bottleneck concrete.
shots.framing: Three distinct people above a converging document queue and a large coral pending-action panel.
shots.subject: The narrated imagined freelancers and their shared approval problem.
shots.action: Begin with three separate reports. Move the outer documents inward along converging connectors until all three accumulate behind the coral pending action. Hold on the blockage; do not show approval or payment.
shots.continuity: Repeat the prior cards' coral unresolved marker. This scene belongs to the narration's imagined example, not observed demand; the next shot inspects its mechanism.

shots.purpose: Replace premature coding with investigation of the existing workaround, recurrence, and time cost, without inventing measurements.
shots.framing: A large three-stage workflow with a blocked handoff, a return loop, and an unlabeled clock cue.
shots.subject: Inspection of the existing approval workflow.
shots.action: Trace the documents toward the coral checkpoint. Stop there, expose the lower return route, and trace one deliberate loop back to the first document. Reveal clock hands as a question to investigate, not an elapsed-time result.
shots.continuity: Carry the same queue into a process view. The return route explains why repeated chasing could consume time; the following interviews test that possibility.

shots.purpose: Specify five interviews and direct observation of workflows rather than requests for approval of an app idea.
shots.framing: Five distinct people in two balanced rows above a shared workflow inspection area.
shots.subject: Five interview targets and the workflow they would be asked to demonstrate.
shots.action: Keep all five people separate and visible. Bring the two workflow documents into a connected sequence beneath them, then expose the coral handoff between those documents. This plans interviews; it does not depict completed research or endorsements.
shots.continuity: The prior workflow becomes the interview subject. Preserve the blockage rather than replacing it with approval badges or positive reactions.

shots.purpose: Offer a simple paid service with manual steps, and explicitly return to searching when nobody is willing to pay.
shots.framing: Manual service and payment checkpoint above a clearly connected lower return route.
shots.subject: An unaccepted paid offer, not a completed transaction.
shots.action: Move the service document from the person toward the payment checkpoint, but stop before the coin. Under the unpaid condition, move the document down and left along the return route into the search browser. Hold on the renewed search; show no money transfer.
shots.continuity: The inspected workflow informs the offer. The return route makes failure to obtain willingness to pay consequential; the next shot separately presents the conditional paying branch.

shots.purpose: Keep payment explicitly conditional, then connect complaints, repeated problems, and paying customers to distinct levels of evidence without implying a successful sale.
shots.framing: Persistent complaint queue above a conditional payment checkpoint and a compact bottleneck-specific tool.
shots.subject: The conditional build decision and the evidence hierarchy.
shots.action: Keep the heading “If someone pays” throughout. Converge separate complaint documents into the familiar queue. Preview the conditional branch by placing a small tool at the blocked handoff and opening a narrow mint route around it. Keep the coin stationary and separate: no customer payment is enacted. Finish with the queue, checkpoint, and tool all visible as the narration distinguishes complaints, opportunities, and business evidence.
shots.continuity: This is the alternative to the preceding unpaid return path, not its successful outcome. Mint marks only the proposed tool's bottleneck-removal route; payment and business viability remain conditional.

segment.note: First 20 seconds, exact shared source audio. Compare same frames in later variants; no new narration authorized or generated.
